posts.title: On Dippin'
posts.description: On Dippin' Haven't written anything in ages, so I figured I'm overdue for an update. Since the last post, I've: taken a new job at Jane Street, working on virtualization gotten a dog (see pic) gone to Libya (another post to come there) biked from Pittsburgh to DC (likely another post to come) As stereotypical as it sounds, getting the dog has forced me to become more responsible in some banal ways
